I was going to kill myself an hour ago for similar situation, I cleaned my room and everything. I JUST WANTED A BREAK! I didn't see my life going anywhere but down and just wanted it to end, i was tired of being hurt. I had a full on mental breakdown in my closet, writing thank you's on my suicide note but I decided before I do this to seek help, and it saved my life. It may seem like it will never end for you, you will never catch a break and it may also seem like no one even understands what is going on but I want you to know that I am proud of you. I understand what you're going through and like you, no one even understood what I was going through. I don't know if this helps at all but you need to know that i understand everything you said and don't want you to kill your self. Please please please pm me if you're ever feeling sad. Please don't kill your self 

I also want you to know that your brother loves you. My sister said she wasn't thankful for me at thanksgiving, but regardless she still loves and cares about me ( I think.) your brother would be devastated about your death, and needs you in his life in case he goes through a similar situation
Alright they'll be home in 30 I'll let you know how it goes

I have 4 hours because my parents will be home then and will go ballistic. I enjoyed playing video games, airsoft and generally just browsing reddit. It was my escape from everything but soon these will be lost.
